model.method: Pressure (selected, A) = death overs, or a chase needing ≥9 an over, or a collapse (≥3 down for ≤35); chosen over leverage definitions because player value under it repeats more across matches (definitionComparison). Leverage = E|ΔWP| of the next ball from calibrated logistic win-probability models. Value = runs vs context expectation (innings × over × wickets, competition-season scaled) minus wicket cost (drop in expected remaining runs).

definitionComparison.label: A. Rules: death overs, or chase needing ≥9 an over, or collapse (≥3 down for ≤35)
C. Rules, but only while the match is live (batting side's win probability 2–98%)
B. Leverage, top 40% of balls (same share as the rules)
Difficulty: batting side's win probability 5–35% (behind but alive)
